newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody"s says may cut Showa Denko long-term rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody"s says may cut Showa Denko long-term rating.

text.p: Moody"s Investors Service said on Wednesday that it had placed Showa Denko KK"s Ba3 long-term debt rating under review for possible downgrading.

The review reflected concern over the chemical company"s financial flexibility and its ability to withstand the next downturn in its core chemical business, Moody"s said in a statement. margins and cash flow through extensive cost cutting, the rating agency said.
Moody"s said it would also study Showa Denko"s plans to revitalise its weakened financial condition.
The company has been pursuing out-of-court settlements of certain U.S. liability lawsuits involving L-Tryptophan, an amino acid product it once produced, Moody"s said.
Showa Denko had already paid a large sum as part of the settlements and the peak spending on this matter appeared to be behind it, but the ultimate cost remained uncertain, Moody"s said.
